name: io.github.Mr-Macharia/mpesa-daraja-mcp
title: M-Pesa Daraja
description: Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja tools: STK Push, C2B, B2C, B2B, QR, Ratiba. Sandbox-first, idempotent.

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Daraja app Consumer Key

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_CONSUMER_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Daraja app Consumer Secret

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_ENV
environmentVariables.description: sandbox (default) or production

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_SHORTCODE
environmentVariables.description: Paybill / store number (174379 in sandbox)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_PASSKEY
environmentVariables.description: M-Pesa Express passkey (STK Push)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_INITIATOR_NAME
environmentVariables.description: API operator username (B2C, B2B, status, balance, reversal)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_SECURITY_CREDENTIAL
environmentVariables.description: Encrypted initiator password

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_CALLBACK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public HTTPS base for callback URLs

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_CALLBACK_LISTEN
environmentVariables.description: host:port for the built-in callback receiver

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_CALLBACK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: 16+ random characters; secret path for callbacks

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list: stk,c2b,payouts,ops,qr,ratiba,billmanager

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true hides every tool that moves money or writes

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD
environmentVariables.description: Payouts above this many shillings need approval in the chat

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma list of phones/shortcodes that payouts may go to

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_ALLOW_LIVE_MONEY_MOVEMENT
environmentVariables.description: true to allow production charges and payouts

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_INITIATOR_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Initiator password, encrypted into SecurityCredential at startup (alternative to DARAJA_SECURITY_CREDENTIAL)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to Safaricom's public certificate, used with DARAJA_INITIATOR_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_STATE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path of the SQLite file that stores request state and callbacks

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where generated QR PNGs are saved

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the saved config (default: user config dir)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_DOTENV
environmentVariables.description: Path of a .env file to load instead of the project one

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for HTTP mode (32+ random characters)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP mode bind address (default 127.0.0.1)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP mode port (default 8000)

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_FORWARD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your app's URL: every callback is POSTed on to it, HMAC-signed

environmentVariables.name: DARAJA_FORWARD_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: HMAC secret for forwarded callbacks (16+ characters)
